verdict.rationale: Workable is a recruiting platform with automation features (the Workable Agent, webhooks, API, MCP server), so the story's axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Webhook subscriptions and API endpoints are building blocks, not version control for automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
